translations.web: Yahweh has established his throne in the heavens. His kingdom rules over all.
translations.bsb: The LORD has established His throne in heaven, and His kingdom rules over all.
translations.kjv: The LORD hath prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom ruleth
translations.asv: Jehovah hath established his throne in the heavens; And his kingdom ruleth over all.
